source: Yahoo Finance | CRON 2026-10-12: H1 2026 column completed from Absa Group Limited unaudited consolidated results for the interim reporting period ended 30 June 2026, the full SENS announcement, figures in R million. Printed consolidated statement of comprehensive income: operating profit before income tax 18 841; taxation expense 4 841; profit for the reporting period 14 000; profit attributable to ordinary equity holders 12 579; basic earnings per ordinary share 1 517.9 cents. The commentary prints operating expenses of R31 393m and a cost to income ratio of 53.4 percent, which reproduces R31 393m on the printed revenue of R58 791m. Operating Expenses is that printed figure. Profit Before Tax is the printed operating profit before income tax. Income Tax is the printed taxation expense. Net Profit is stored as the printed profit attributable to ordinary equity holders of R12 579m, the measure the file own annual columns carry: FY2025 22 214m is the printed profit attributable to ordinary equity holders for that year. The printed profit for the reporting period of R14 000m includes R1 421m attributable to non controlling interests and additional tier 1 capital holders, which the issuer prints separately. Revenue 58 791 and EPS 15.179 were already stored and are unchanged. A bank presents no cost of sales or gross profit line, so those cells stay empty.
